friend
朋友
How would you stay close to a friend who moved far away?
I would arrange a regular call with my friend. Sharing ordinary stories would keep us connected between visits.
我會和朋友約好固定通話。平常的小事也聊聊，見不到面時仍能保持聯繫。
friendship
友誼
What helps a friendship survive a disagreement?
A friendship lasts when both people can explain what hurt them. Listening matters more than winning every point.
能說清楚自己為什麼受傷，友誼才比較能繼續。仔細聽，比每一句都爭贏重要。
family
家人
How would you include family members who cannot attend a celebration?
I would call my family during a quiet part of the celebration. We could also send photos and save stories to share later.
我會在慶祝活動比較空的時候打給家人。也傳些照片，把有趣的事留著之後聊。
parent
家長
What could a parent do when a child is nervous about a new activity?
A parent could visit the place with the child beforehand. Knowing what to expect might make the first day less frightening.
家長可以事先陪孩子去看看環境。知道會遇到什麼，第一天就比較不害怕。
partner
夥伴
How would you choose a partner for a demanding shared task?
I would choose a partner who communicates clearly about difficulties. Being able to ask for help matters more than appearing perfect.
我會找能清楚說明困難的夥伴。願意開口求助，比看起來什麼都會更重要。
relationship
關係
How would you maintain a good relationship with a busy sibling?
I would keep the relationship warm through short, thoughtful messages. We would not need a long conversation every time we checked in.
我會用簡短但貼心的訊息維持關係。關心彼此，不一定每次都要長聊。
trust
信任
How could someone rebuild trust after breaking a promise?
They could rebuild trust by making smaller promises they can keep. Consistent actions would matter more than a dramatic apology.
可以先從做得到的小承諾，慢慢重建信任。持續做到，比一次很盛大的道歉更重要。
honest
誠實
How would you be honest when a friend asks for your opinion on their work?
I would be honest about one part that needs improvement. I would also explain what already works rather than dismiss the whole effort.
我會誠實指出一個需要改進的地方。也說明哪些部分做得好，不否定整份努力。
kind
親切
What kind action could make a newcomer feel less awkward?
A kind action would be inviting them into a small conversation. I would explain any shared references instead of leaving them outside the joke.
親切的做法，是主動邀他加入聊天。聊到共同經驗時也補充說明，不讓他只能在旁邊陪笑。
polite
有禮貌
How would you politely end a conversation when you need to leave?
I would give a polite explanation that I need to go. Thanking the person for the conversation would make the ending warmer.
我會有禮貌地說明自己得先走。也謝謝對方剛才的聊天，讓結束不那麼突然。
generous
慷慨
Can someone be generous without spending much money?
Someone can be generous with their time and attention. Helping a friend with an exhausting task can mean more than an expensive gift.
願意花時間、用心陪伴，也是一種慷慨。幫朋友處理累人的事，可能比昂貴禮物更珍貴。
support
支持
How would you support a friend facing an important decision?
I would support my friend by asking what matters most to them. I would not turn the decision into a choice I made for them.
我會先問朋友最在意什麼，給他支持。不把他的決定，變成我替他選好的答案。
encourage
鼓勵
How would you encourage someone after an unsuccessful attempt?
I would encourage them by pointing out a specific improvement. Then I would ask what they wanted to try differently next time.
我會指出他確實進步的地方來鼓勵他。再問下次想換哪個方法試試看。
apologize
道歉
What should you include when you apologize for interrupting someone?
I would apologize for cutting them off and invite them to finish. I would not add an excuse that made the apology disappear.
我會為打斷他道歉，請他繼續說完。不加一堆藉口，把道歉的意思都沖淡了。
forgive
原諒
Does choosing to forgive someone mean you must trust them immediately?
I can forgive someone without restoring trust immediately. I may still need time and clearer boundaries before the relationship feels safe.
我可以原諒對方，但不必立刻恢復信任。可能還需要時間和清楚的界線，才能安心相處。
argument
爭論
How would you stop a small argument from taking over an evening?
I would pause the argument and name the actual disagreement. We could return to that one issue after both people had calmed down.
我會先暫停爭論，說清楚真正有分歧的是什麼。等彼此冷靜，再回來談那一件事。
disagree
不同意
How would you disagree with a friend's plan without dismissing their idea?
I would explain why I disagree and suggest an adjustment. Acknowledging the useful part of the plan would keep the discussion constructive.
我會說明不同意的原因，也提出調整方式。肯定計畫有用的部分，討論才比較能繼續。
compromise
妥協
Two friends want different holiday activities. What compromise could work?
A compromise could give each person one day to choose. We would still agree on a shared budget and realistic travel time.
可以妥協成每人選一天的活動。預算和交通時間，仍要先一起確認可不可行。
boundary
界線
How would you set a boundary about late-night calls?
I would explain my boundary before another late call happens. Friends could message first unless the situation was genuinely urgent.
我會在下次深夜來電前，就先說好界線。除非真的有急事，不然先傳訊息問問。
listen
聽
What helps you listen when you strongly disagree with someone?
I try to listen for the concern behind their opinion. Understanding that concern does not require me to accept every conclusion.
我會試著聽出對方意見背後的擔心。理解他的顧慮，不代表必須接受所有結論。
care
照顧
How could you share the care of a family member with others?
We could share the care by assigning specific visits and errands. A written plan would stop everything falling to one person.
我們可以把照顧工作分成探訪和採買等項目。寫成安排，就不容易全落在同一個人身上。
grateful
感激
How would you show someone you are grateful for practical help?
I would say exactly why I was grateful. A note about how their help changed my day would feel more personal than a vague thanks.
我會說清楚自己為什麼感激。寫下他的幫忙如何改變了那一天，比泛泛地說謝謝更有心。
lonely
孤單
What could help someone who feels lonely after moving to a new town?
A regular activity could help them feel less lonely. Seeing the same people each week creates chances for friendships to grow.
固定參加活動，可能減少孤單的感覺。每週見到同一群人，才有慢慢熟悉的機會。
reunion
重聚
How would you plan a reunion that includes people with busy lives?
I would plan the reunion well ahead and keep it simple. A relaxed afternoon might attract more people than a complicated weekend trip.
我會提早安排重聚，活動也盡量簡單。輕鬆的一個下午，可能比整個週末旅行更容易成行。
